name: Roblox Corporation
blurb: Roblox Corporation operates an online platform that allows users to create, share, and play games and experiences. The company generates revenue through the sale of virtual currency (Robux) and in-game purchases. As of early 2025, Roblox has a market capitalization of approximately $31.45 billion and is a leading player in the metaverse and user-generated content space.
recent: In the past 30 days, Roblox stock has experienced volatility, with shares trading near $44 as of late February 2025, down from a 52-week high of $150.59. The company reported mixed earnings, with revenue growth but ongoing losses, contributing to a negative P/E ratio of -27.92. Analysts have noted concerns about user growth and monetization, while some remain optimistic about long-term potential.
